1.consolidated_definition: Planta ramosa con hojas finalmente divididas y flores de color amarillo con disco rojizo oscuro; es ornamental. Asteraceae Calliopsis tinctoria.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Branched plant with ultimately divided leaves and yellow flowers with a dark reddish-brown disc; it is ornamental. Asteraceae Calliopsis tinctoria.
